tighten_only: This list only denies. It never allows anything, and no entry widens a permission.
ascend_note: slash-eureka holds the Ascend repos (AUH action-underwriting-hub, MCP ascend-mcp, OPS data-ops, DBT dbt, OMN omni). Reads and edits are denied under the whole tree.

push_deny.force_reason: force-push in any form is denied
push_deny.protected_reason: pushing to main or master is denied; push a task branch instead
push_deny.bulk_reason: bulk pushes (--all, --mirror, matching or wildcard refspecs) can write main or master; push a named task branch
push_deny.ambiguous_reason: this push has no explicit destination branch that can be resolved; name a task branch, for example `git push -u origin <task-branch>`
push_deny.note: A push is judged from the destination ref of its refspecs (the right side of src:dst, with a leading + or refs/heads/ ignored), read from the real git push command the shell would run. A push with no refspec (or HEAD) goes where git's configuration sends it, so the destination comes from `git push --dry-run --porcelain` with the same options in the command's directory; it is refused when a listed destination is protected, when git fails, times out or lists nothing, and after a cd. --all, --mirror, matching and wildcard refspecs are refused. A protected branch name anywhere else in the command text (a PR body, an hc message, a commit message, a heredoc) is not a push to it.

t3_gate_instance.note: T3 applies a provider instance's environment to every thread launched on it, and the thread-launch input has no environment field. This instance is therefore the only channel that can hand a launched Claude gate its role. The launcher that selects it is part 2 of #534, and the guard refuses a thread launch that names it from a caller without the role.

merge_deny.reason: gh pr merge is denied for builders; only a gate thread may merge
merge_deny.pin_reason: a gate merges only with the pinned --match-head-commit head as a merge argument

ascend_bash_reason: reads and edits under ~/Code/slash-eureka (Ascend) are denied
secret_bash_reason: commands on secret files (.env, auth.json, keys, tokens, ~/.ssh) are denied

hook.note: permissions.deny cannot express 'gh pr merge unless the caller is a gate and --match-head-commit carries a commit id', nor can it name every remote a push targets, so those rules live in this PreToolUse hook in the same settings file. The hook denies a main/master push on any remote and any force-push, which is why the enumerate-as-remote entries below are only the common spellings. The matcher covers the Bash tool and every T3 thread tool by name substring, so the hook's thread-tool check runs when a builder asks to launch or steer a thread on the gate instance; a Bash-only matcher would leave that check unreachable.

scope_files.note: runtime/pi/AGENTS.md is committed here (it is already the live scope file for the router, glm, minimax and deepseek through symlinks); the installer writes the same section into the two unlinked copies and into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.

scope_section: A machine guard enforces this list before tools run; prose cannot override it.
The list lives in `mac-ops runtime/agents/deny-rules.json` and `scripts/install_deny_rules.py` installs it.
- No reads or edits under `~/Code/slash-eureka` (the Ascend repos: AUH, MCP, OPS, DBT, OMN).
- No reads or edits of secret files: `.env` files, `auth.json`, key and token files, `~/.ssh`.
- No force-push in any form, and no push to `main` or `master`. Pushing a task branch stays allowed.
- No `gh pr merge` for a builder. Only a gate thread merges, and only with the pinned `--match-head-commit` head given as a merge argument.
